body_lead: BusinessWire India Los Altos (California) [US]/Bangalore (Karnataka) [India], May 31: Bihar State Power Holding Company Limited (BSPHCL) has adopted Bidgely's artificial intelligence (AI)-powered Energy Theft Solution to enhance the discom's energy theft detection and revenue leakage prevention strategies. Bidgely's AI technology, which analyzes smart meter data to flag anomalous behaviors and patterns in consumer energy usage, has already flagged over 136 potential cases of theft. All cases were inspected and an assessment was raised in almost 63 percent of the tariff misuse cases.
